While the weak-kneed globalists and progressive elites sit around wringing their hands over rising energy prices and canceled flights while death and destruction fill screens, the Israeli people understand what national survival actually takes.

That is what happens when a society prioritizes strength, security, and cultural continuity over the cowardly hand-wringing coming out of international institutions. While the modern West loses its moral compass and forgets personal responsibility, the Israelis are showing us all how a nation stands firm to protect its homeland. We need that kind of unyielding authority and defense of family values right here at home, rather than bowing down to weakness.
